description: This Java source file defines the LogDivertAppender class, a custom log appender for diverting logs from individual threads to their associated LogObject, with filtering based on logging levels and logger names.

classes.name: LogDivertAppender
classes.description: A custom Log4j appender that diverts logs from individual threads to their corresponding LogObject, with filtering based on logger name patterns and logging levels.

classes.name: LogDivertAppender.NameFilter
classes.description: A filter class that filters log events based on logger name patterns and current logging level, to prevent infinite loops and control verbosity.
